customManagers.description: Go's version, from go.dev's release list: the `go` directive of every go.mod and go.work. nix/go.nix overrides nixpkgs' go_1_NN onto it; renovate-pins.yaml derives the source hash.

packageRules.description: The `go` directive belongs to the go regex manager above; left on, gomod would bump it alone in a PR of its own.

The PR that moves the locked nixpkgs. It touches no toolchain version: nix/ overrides nixpkgs' package onto the declared patch while the two differ, and .github/workflows/renovate-pins.yaml drops the override's hashes from nix/toolchains.json once the lock catches up. After the major gate on purpose — the later rule wins.
A new Go minor is a new nixpkgs line (go_1_NN), so it waits on the dashboard until nixpkgs packages it; nix/go.nix throws on a line it does not have. Patches open straight away.
The SDK is pinned to the Streamline commit whose extension contract this module is built for; moving it is a decision, not a routine bump.
